“The SDGs are the universally-
agreed road map to bridge 
economic and geopolitical divides, 
restore trust and rebuilt solidarity. 
Failure to make progress means 
inequalities will continue to 
deepen, increasing the risk of a 
fragmented, two-speed world.  
No country can afford to see  
the 2030 Agenda fail.”
 
António Guterres
SECREARY-GENERAL OF THE UNITED NATIONS
This briefing book was created to share key messages

is briefing book was created to share key messages and data 
on the current progress of the SDGs at the halfway point.
The data and key messages comes from the Sustainable 
Development Goals Report 2023: Special Edition produced by 
UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs. Key messages 
were also sourced from official public statements from the 
UN Secretary-General and UN Deputy Secretary-General. The 
implementation stories come from our colleagues at UN News.
The UN Office for Partnerships is your

at UN News.
The UN Office for Partnerships is your global gateway to the 
United Nations. Around the world, we convene and co-create 
partnership opportunities to accelerate solutions to keep the 
promise of the Sustainable Development Goals. 
Learn more at unpartnerships.un.org.
